result.summary: The page generally looks correct, but the Orders tab in the bottom navigation is missing its icon. Other partial items fall under the requested exclusions (carousel clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff).

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar displays its label but has no visible icon above it, while Home, Search, and Profile all show both icons and labels.
issues.suggestion: Add or restore the Orders icon asset and ensure it is rendered with the correct tint/color so it is visible against the tab bar background.
